# Outlier

> Mac-native local AI runtime with a custom paged Mixture-of-
> Experts inference engine. Runs frontier-scale models like
> Qwen3.5-397B-A17B on 64GB Apple Silicon Macs by streaming
> expert weights off SSD. Offline, no API tokens, no usage caps.
> Includes a Claude-Code-class agent loop (plan / act / verify /
> recover), MCP connectors, Projects, Code Agent v2, and 7 model
> tiers from 4B to 397B.

## Pricing
- Free: Nano 4B + Lite 9B, no account, no token bill
- Pro: $20/mo or $149/yr — all 7 tiers including Plus 397B, Marathon mode, Computer use, Deep Research v3, long context to 128K
- Founding 200: $99 lifetime Pro, 200 seat cap (sells first)
- Founders 500: $200 lifetime Pro, 500 seat cap (opens after Founding 200)
